data_audit.source_scope: 35 immutable runs; per-run artifact and summary consistency plus configuration grouping

deterministic_replay.scope: two isolated replicas, current tracker, seed 57721, 1000 parcels

confirmed_findings.detail: All 35 audited immutable runs passed required-file, manifest-hash, summary/NPZ length, impact-mass, target-mass, strict fallback, and strict hit-ratio checks.
The run root contains four separate configuration/implementation groups. The root-level audit is failed by design because those groups must not be pooled.
The five-run 20k group with seeds 57721, 104729, 130363, 161027, 196613 has zero individual audit errors and one shared physical-config signature.
Two independent remote replicas with the current tracker produced byte-identical particle_hits.npz, summary.json, and particle_run_manifest.json.
confirmed_findings.limitation: This excludes nondeterminism at the tested scale; it does not prove particle spatial convergence or physical accuracy.

confirmed_findings.detail: The clean five-run historical group has low effective impact support and very high collision-candidate diagnostic overhead.
confirmed_findings.interpretation: The spatial field is supported by a small fraction of parcels, while strict collision processing spends substantial work on near-miss candidate checks. This combination can produce both high spatial variance and unacceptable runtime.

confirmed_findings.detail: Current DCU tracker hash is 8ccf474cca5035c91d68b41c84bfd7a8defd3920040e4759a0cba076583af8f3, while the clean historical group used b58d2d3eb2b6d2dbf42f5fc19f6f4778dbc41ae0c77857b326bc15197fd372d5.

root_cause_conclusion.primary: sparse strict physical hit support drives spatial Monte Carlo variance
root_cause_conclusion.secondary: strict tracking path has large near-miss and substep runtime overhead
root_cause_conclusion.excluded_as_primary_at_smoke_scale: nondeterministic random-number or parallel execution behavior
still_unresolved: whether current-code tracker version change alters hit support relative to historical groups

next_experiments.design: same seed and inputs; compare strict run with exact near-miss distance diagnostic disabled or sampled, while preserving strict intersection acceptance
next_experiments.success_metric: same hit arrays and summary physics fields; lower runtime and no change in accepted intersections

next_experiments.design: one factor at a time over strict_max_substep, dt, interpolation and integrator
next_experiments.success_metric: trajectory/impact stability separated from runtime effect

next_experiments.design: independent m/mm, transform, wall-sample, normal-angle and UMean semantics audit before spatial scoring
next_experiments.success_metric: nonzero matched-face mask with declared registration thresholds

next_experiments.design: fresh artifact set, one implementation hash, pre-registered hit-support target and timeout based on remote smoke benchmark
next_experiments.success_metric: active-face and declared-resolution JS <= 0.05; raw parent-face result reported separately

score_change.reason: Determinism and data integrity are prerequisites; spatial JS and physical registration gates remain failed or blocked.
